<div class="card-body">
'''Spice Mines Of Kessel''' is a [[Dark]] [[Effect]] ([[Utinni Effect]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ケッセルのスパイス鉱床</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">ケッセルに配備する（移動不可）。捕虜を1名と、その護衛として兵員／トルーパーを1名、目標として選ぶ。目標がウーティーニー・エフェクトに到達したら、捕虜の没収値と同じ数だけフォースを再使用する（捕虜とウーティーニー・エフェクトはロストする）。到達する前に兵員／トルーパーがロストしたなら、捕虜は解放される。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Spice-Mines-Of-Kessel-PSA-156625015.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ケッセルのスパイス鉱床に送られた囚人は、密輸屋や犯罪王たちが銀河中に売りさばくスパイス、グリッタースティムを掘って余生を過ごすことになる。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Spice Mines Of Kessel.

'''Card text:'''
Deploy on Kessel (cannot move). Target one captive and one soldier/trooper as escort. When the targets reach the Utinni Effect, reuse Force equal to the captive's forfeit; the captive and Utinni Effect are lost. If the soldier/trooper is lost before arrival, the captive is released.

'''Lore:'''
Prisoners sent to the Kessel spice mines spend the rest of their lives digging glitterstim, a spice smugglers and crime lords sell across the galaxy.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Escort is 兵員／トルーパー, not bare trooper.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Spice Mines Of Kessel]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
